interface.title: EukaSurvey — The Genomic Resource Explorer for Eukaryotes
interface.stage_of_work: Study design and data discovery: checking which public genomic resources exist before a comparative study or grant proposal
interface.what_it_is_for: Pick any eukaryotic clade and see what share of its species have a genome assembly, an annotation, short-read RNA-seq or long-read RNA-seq, overall and broken down by taxonomic rank on a phylogenetic tree with coverage bars.

data.note: A local pre-built database (sidebar reads 'Database · local build') of counts from NCBI (assemblies), Annotrieve (annotations) and ENA (RNA-seq). The default root on load was Eukaryota (2759), not Mammalia as the code notes said. No Wikipedia blurb appeared in the summary box, which may be because the app is offline. A pyarrow/NumPy version clash ('ImportError: pyarrow requires NumPy 2.0 or newer, found 1.26.4') crashes every table drawn with st.dataframe: the Table tab, the Export Data preview and therefore the TSV exports too.
